messages:
Kelsey Harper: Quick noteHey all, I accepted an external offer; my last day will be 2026-04-02. Need clarity on COBRA timelines, final pay/PTO payout, device return, and who to add as owner on Figma projects.

Marta (People Ops): Congrats, Kelsey! :tada: COBRA: 60 days from loss of coverage. Coverage stops 4/30 unless you elect COBRA earlier. We'll DM the enrollment link and FAQ. Please review the benefits checklist we send.

Kelsey Harper: Thanks. Is the COBRA link time-limited?

Marta (People Ops): Yes, the link is unique but valid for the full 60-day election period. You'll also get a paper notice for records.

Alex (IT): For laptop: ship with pre-paid label or drop off. We'll remote-wipe after we confirm delivery. Please remove personal accounts first. Address we use: 1200 Inference Way, Suite 400, SF.

Kelsey Harper: Can you send label + confirm remote wipe window?

Alex (IT): Sending label via DM today. Wipe executed within 72 hours of receipt unless a retention hold is requested by People Ops.

Ben (Payroll): PTO payout: paid on the next monthly payroll after termination paperwork clears; taxed per usual. If you need exact date, DM payroll with your termination date.

Kelsey Harper: I have RSUs vesting 4/15. Who do I contact?

Marta (People Ops): I'll loop in Stock Admin off-channel and forward their confirmation.

People Ops Bot: Exit interview link sent to Kelsey via DM - please complete before departure.

Kelsey Harper: Appreciate it. I'll transfer Figma ownership to Priya today and confirm here. Thanks everyone. :)
